_about: Trinkets (Robin, 2026-11-03: "There will be no necklaces, instead its gonna be trinkets for that slot"): each gives a passive of its own, in or out of a fight, and nothing else: no stats (Robin, 2026-11-03: yes). Found, never on a shop’s shelves (a town’s fine piece of the day may be one): a drop for the trinket slot draws one of the rolled rarity whose tier the land has reached, the land’s own tier and the two before it three times as often. Robin’s five examples are Traveller’s Bread, Twin Fangs, Gambler’s Die, Sapphire Tear and Storm Charm; the rest, every number and where each is found are mine. "look" is for Mitch, AD’s icons.

lightning._about: A trinket’s lightning: a bolt of this share of a blow, and an ordinary creature loses its next move; minis and bosses take the damage and shrug off the stun (Robin, 2026-11-03: yes).

travellers-bread.name: Traveller’s Bread
travellers-bread.text: After each fight you win out in the world (not the Arena), you heal 10 HP.

lucky-acorn.name: Lucky Acorn
lucky-acorn.look: an acorn with a shiny cap

rabbits-foot.name: Rabbit’s Foot
rabbits-foot.text: A 30% chance of +1 on a roll for a prize.
rabbits-foot.look: a rabbit’s foot on a string

misers-coin.name: Miser’s Coin
misers-coin.text: Twice the gold from every fight, half the XP.

copper-bell.name: Copper Bell
copper-bell.text: Each fight starts behind a barrier of 5% of your HP.

sapphire-tear.name: Sapphire Tear
sapphire-tear.text: Three more mana back every round of a fight.

thorn-ring.name: Thorn Ring
thorn-ring.text: 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.

gamblers-die.name: Gambler’s Die
gamblers-die.text: After a roll you may walk one step fewer or one more: roll a 5 and walk 4, 5 or 6.

hearth-loaf.name: Hearth Loaf
hearth-loaf.text: After each fight you win out in the world, you heal 40 HP.

owl-feather.name: Owl Feather
owl-feather.text: At night the wild’s creatures are no stronger against you, and still pay their night bonus.

bottled-storm.name: Bottled Storm
bottled-storm.text: You regain 2% of your mana each round.
bottled-storm.look: a corked bottle with a cloud inside

storm-charm.name: Storm Charm
storm-charm.text: Each Attack has a 5% chance to call down lightning: extra damage, and an ordinary creature loses its next move.

lucky-charm.name: Four-Leaf Clover
lucky-charm.text: Roll the die again once every five minutes: a Reroll chip appears after a roll.
lucky-charm.look: a four-leaf clover pressed in glass

heartstone.name: Heartstone
heartstone.text: Heals a twentieth of your HP at the end of every round in a fight.

hunters-horn.name: Hunter’s Horn
hunters-horn.text: 25% more damage in the first round.

saints-tooth.name: Saint’s Tooth
saints-tooth.text: Your healing and your flasks work 20% better.
saints-tooth.look: a tooth in a little silver cage

ember-stone.name: Ember Stone
ember-stone.text: A burning foe takes 12% more, and your burns hurt 20% more.

twin-fangs.name: Twin Fangs
twin-fangs.text: Attack strikes twice as many times, each at half the damage: two hits instead of one, six for a Rogue. Every hit can crit, poison or drain.

herb-satchel.name: Herb Satchel
herb-satchel.text: After each fight you win out in the world, you heal 100 HP.

moonwell-stone.name: Moonwell Stone
moonwell-stone.text: Six more mana back every round of a fight.

iron-heart.name: Iron Heart
iron-heart.text: Under a third of your HP you take 20% less.

sand-of-patience.name: Sand of Patience
sand-of-patience.text: Start each fight with 2 points of your meter.

phoenix-feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix-feather.text: When you would fall, you rise where you stand with half your HP instead, once every half hour.

wolf-totem.name: Wolf Totem
wolf-totem.text: Every point of your meter has a one-in-four chance to bring a second.

wishbone.name: Wishbone
wishbone.text: Once a fight, when you drop under a quarter of your HP, 15% of it comes back.

thunder-bell.name: Thunder Bell
thunder-bell.text: Each Attack has an 8% chance to call down lightning: extra damage, and an ordinary creature loses its next move.
thunder-bell.look: a bronze bell crackling with sparks

drowned-compass.name: Drowned Compass
drowned-compass.text: Each win heals 4% of your HP and gives back 8% of your mana.
drowned-compass.look: a compass green with the sea

giants-knucklebone.name: Giant’s Knucklebone
giants-knucklebone.text: 25% more damage to a foe under a third of its HP.

seven-league-pebble.name: Seven-League Pebble
seven-league-pebble.text: After a roll you may walk up to two steps fewer or more: roll a 4 and walk anywhere from 2 to 6.
seven-league-pebble.look: a smooth pebble with a boot carved on it

dragons-heart.name: Dragon’s Heart
dragons-heart.text: Heals 3% of your HP every round, and each fight starts behind a barrier of 10% of your HP.

stormheart.name: Stormheart
stormheart.text: Each Attack has a 10% chance to call down lightning, and 5% more crits.
stormheart.look: a storm cloud caught in crystal

crown-jewel.name: Crown Jewel
crown-jewel.text: 10% more HP and attack, and 5% more crits.

twin-moons.name: Twin Moons
twin-moons.text: Attack strikes twice as many times at half the damage each, and 5% more crits.
twin-moons.look: two little moons on one chain

dreamcatcher.name: Dreamcatcher
dreamcatcher.text: Half as much Dreamdust again from everything in the Dream.
dreamcatcher.look: a little willow hoop with a feather web

lucid-bead.name: Lucid Bead
lucid-bead.text: When you fall in the Dream, you keep half the gold the run had won.
lucid-bead.look: a clear glass bead with a tiny open eye inside

sleepers-bell.name: Sleeper’s Bell
sleepers-bell.text: Each win heals 6% of your HP and gives back 10% of your mana.
sleepers-bell.look: a small silver bell stuffed with wool

moth-wing.name: Moth Wing
moth-wing.text: 8% more dodge, and once a fight, when you drop under a quarter of your HP, 20% of it comes back.
moth-wing.look: a pale moth wing set in silver

nightmare-shard.name: Nightmare Shard
nightmare-shard.text: 35% more damage to a foe under a third of its HP, and 6% more crits.
nightmare-shard.look: a black splinter that drinks the light

morning-star.name: Morning Star
morning-star.look: a small star, still pink at its edges
